headline: FLYDUBAI 🛫 CO-PILOT 🧑‍✈️ AXE 🚪 ATTACKS 🪓 CAPTAIN 😱
text:
FLYDUBAI 🛫 CO-PILOT 🧑‍✈️ named 🏷️ Hamam 🧔 al-Hammami 🧔 tried 💥 to HIJACK ✈️ that Israel-bound ✡️ jet 🛩️ by SMASHING 🪓 the captain 🧑‍✈️ with a CRASH 🚨 axe 🪓 according 🔍 to the UAE 🇦🇪 prosecutor 👨‍⚖️ general 🧑‍⚖️!! This Omani 🇴🇲 national 🇳🇴 who got 🚫 booted 😤 from Oman 🇴🇲 Air ✈️ training 🏋️ over radical 🕌 views 👀 later 📅 stabbed 🔪 Capt 🧑‍✈️ Smit 🛡️ Machchhar 🛡️ in the cockpit 🚪 causing 😵 the plane 🛫 to PLUNGE ⬇️ seventeen-thousand 🕳️ feet 🦶 after two-and-a-half ⏰ hours 🕒 into the flight 🛫 carrying 👥 over one-hundred-seventy 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 passengers 🧳!! "I told 🗣️ myself 🪞 to go 🏃 for one last push 👐 to open 🚪 the door 🚪 from inside 🔒" the injured 🤕 captain 🧑‍✈️ said 🗣️ while lying 🛌 on the floor 🧱 allowing 👐 passengers 🧳 to rush 🏃‍♂️ in and overpower 💪 the attacker 🪓 before two reserve ⛑️ pilots 🧑‍✈️ landed 🛬 the jet 🛩️ safely 🛡️ in Saudi 🏜️ Arabia 🇸🇦!!

The weapon 🪓 used 🔫 became 🔥 a massive ❓ question ❓ for investigators 🕵️ since ✈️ security 🛡️ on this sensitive 😬 route 🛣️ is tighter 🪢 than a chastity 🗝️ belt 🩲 yet early 🕒 passenger 🧳 reports 📝 thought 💭 it was a knife 🔪 not the emergency 🚨 crash 🪓 axe 🪓 kept 🔒 in every cockpit 🚪!! Israeli 🇮🇱 Prime Minister 🧔 Benjamin 🕍 Netanyahu 🇮🇱 confirmed ✅ the attacker 🪓 was this same 🧔 Hamam 🧔 al-Hammami 🧔 and after being subdued 🛑 the dude 🧍 screamed 🗣️ "Kill me 🔪 kill me 🔪" which screams 🩸 suicidal 💀 intent 🎯 to Netanyahu 🇮🇱 who added 🗣️ it looked 📉 very likely 🤔 he was gonna 💥 down ⬇️ the plane 🛫 after Islamist 🕌 radical 🧠 indoctrination 🧠!! UAE 🇦🇪 attorney general 👨‍⚖️ Hamad 🧔 Saif 🗡️ Al Shamsi 🇦🇪 called 📞 it a full-on "terrorist act" 🕌 while investigations 🔎 continue 🔄 into motives 🤔 circumstances 🌐 and any possible links ⛓️!!

Brave 🛡️ Capt 🧑‍✈️ Smit 🛡️ Machchhar 🛡️ from India 🇮🇳 got stabbed 🔪 yet still 🩹 found 🧠 the strength 💪 to open 🚪 that cockpit 🚪 door 🚪 from inside 🔒 even while bleeding 🩸 on the floor 🧱 allowing 👐 the heroes 🦸 including Israeli 🇮🇱 woman 👩 Tali 🧕 Manes 👩 to alert 🚨 everyone 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! Her husband 👨 Zvika 👨 plus three other absolute units 💪 Yaniv 🦸 Hayun 🦸 Dr 🩺 Shota 🦸 Musayev 🦸 and Asaf 🦸 Rajuan 🦸 stormed 🏃‍♂️ the cockpit 🚪 where Hayun 🦸 put the attacker 🪓 in a CHOKEHOLD 🥊 and yanked 👐 him out before pinning 📌 the terrorist 🕌 down ⬇️ while literally PULLING 🖐️ the controls 🎮 to level 🛤️ the jet 🛩️ out!! The plane 🛫 had already 📉 dropped ⬇️ like a rollercoaster 🎢 with massive 🌀 G-force 💥 for twenty-to-thirty 🕒 seconds ⏱️ multiple times 🔄 triggering 🚨 the squawk 7700 🆘 then switching 🔄 to 7500 🛑 signaling ✈️ unlawful interference 🚫!!

Indian 🇮🇳 government 🏛️ praised 🙌 Capt 🧑‍✈️ Smit 🛡️ Machchhar 🛡️ for his "immense courage" 🦸 during the entire axe 🪓 attack 🪓 and after being airlifted 🚁 to Abu Dhabi 🏙️ he remains 🛌 in stable 🧘 condition 😌 telling 📢 reporters 📰 "I am confident 🤝 that the recovery 🩹 will be there and I will become fit 💪 and healthy 🌿 again"!! This same 🧔 Hamam 🧔 al-Hammami 🧔 had finished 🎓 a three-year 📅 distance-learning 📚 course 📖 at Buckinghamshire 🏰 New University 🎓 in the UK 🇬🇧 earning 📜 an aviation ✈️ management 📊 degree 🎓 but took zero ✌️ actual pilot 🧑‍✈️ training 🏋️ there and earlier 🚫 got removed ❌ from Oman 🇴🇲 Air ✈️ flight 🛫 training 🏋️ over radical 🕌 views 👀!! Netanyahu 🇮🇱 told 🗣️ Fox 🦊 News 📺 the stabbed 🔪 pilot 🧑‍✈️ brave passengers 🧳 and second crew 👥 managed 🛡️ to prevent 🚫 a nine-eleven 🗼 style disaster 💥 on that Dubai-to-Tel-Aviv 🛫 route 🛣️!!

Passengers 🧳 described 😱 the plunge ⬇️ as sudden 😱 rollercoaster 🎢 drops ⬇️ with insane 🌀 G-forces 💥 that made the jet 🛩️ fall 🍂 rapidly ⚡ for twenty-to-thirty 🕒 seconds ⏱️ before leveling 🛤️ then dropping ⬇️ again 🔄 which sent everyone 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 rushing 🏃‍♂️ toward the cockpit 🚪 after hearing 🔊 the commotion 🗣️ from inside 🚪!! Hayun 🦸 explained 🗣️ in a video 📹 released 📤 by the prime minister's 🧔 office 🏛️ that the attacker 🪓 was desperately 🥴 trying 🏗️ to destroy 💥 the instruments 🎛️ in order 📋 to disable ❌ the plane 🛫 completely 🛑 before getting choked 🥊 pulled 👐 and pinned 📌 by multiple heroes 🦸 who then helped stabilize 🛡️ the controls 🎮 until the reserve ⛑️ pilots 🧑‍✈️ could safely 🛬 land 🛬 in Saudi 🏜️ Arabia 🇸🇦!! Investigations 🔎 by UAE 🇦🇪 authorities 👮 continue 🔄 to dig 🕳️ into every link ⛓️ motive 🤔 and background 🕵️ of this Omani 🇴🇲 co-pilot 🧑‍✈️ turned 🌀 terrorist 🕌 who clearly 🧠 wanted 💀 to take everyone 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 down ⬇️ with him!!
